claim_boundary: Detection uses existing annotated tunnel data. Width is expert-mask-defined natural crack apparent width in pixels, not physical millimetre width or traceable metrology.

detection_selection.aggregation: parent within tunnel, equal tunnel mean
detection_selection.eligibility: mean delta AUPRC >0; mean matched-sensitivity delta FPR <=0; at least 2/3 training tunnels have positive delta AUPRC
detection_selection.objective: maximum mean delta AUPRC; ties prefer smaller profile magnitude

final_gates.detection: panel delta AUPRC mean and 95% CI lower >0; all four tunnels positive; matched-sensitivity delta FPR mean <=0; every detector mean delta AUPRC >=0; panel mean exceeds the frozen v2.3 four-tunnel descriptive mean
final_gates.natural_apparent_width: >=300 ROI, >=100 tiles, >=10 parents, four tunnels; delta absolute-error mean and 95% CI upper <0; >=3/4 tunnels improve; effective non-estimable increase <=2 percentage points; paired estimable rate >=70%

scientific_role: Development-time outer-tunnel cross-fitting on the four supplied tunnels. Each target tunnel is excluded from its route selection. This is not a prospective physically new-site confirmation.

width_selection.aggregation: ROI within tile, tile within parent, equal tunnel mean
width_selection.eligibility: mean delta absolute error <0; at least 2/3 training tunnels improve; effective non-estimable rate no greater than raw
width_selection.objective: minimum mean delta absolute error; ties prefer smaller profile magnitude
width_selection.safe_routing: When raw is ESTIMABLE and the active profile is NON_ESTIMABLE, use the raw measurement. The reference width is never consulted by this routing rule.
